html:
Business owners based in Texarkana, Arkansas depend on bringing in fresh leads and attracting new customers. How successful they are depends on how well they use their marketing and advertising budget. If you’re a business owner wondering how you can grow your Texarkana business with digital marketing, keep reading!

Wondering if you should work with a local digital marketing company, online marketing firm or internet design service? Maybe even a marketing agency? (You should!)

Curious about adding website design and SEO services, or search engine optimization, to your digital marketing strategy? (They can help more people find your business online!)

Been wanting to try out social media marketing? (It could provide the boost your business needs!)

Let’s get into our top three digital marketing tools for bringing more leads and customers to your Texarkana business! But first, let’s take a look at how many customers you could be reaching and how many competitors are out there.

Your Customers and Competition in Texarkana, AR

Here’s a fun fact: almost 76% of Texarkana, AR’s population of 30,000 people has access to the internet at home. That translates to a huge audience of more than 22,000 potential customers you could be reaching with online marketing and digital marketing services right now.

But if you haven’t invested in professional website design, search engine optimization or social media marketing for your business, those potential customers might never see your business—or even know it exists. After all, there are more than 2,400 other small businesses registered in Texarkana, so there’s a ton of competition out there. You need to stand out to get noticed, and these three digital marketing tools can help you do just that!

Tool #1. Professional Website Design and SEO Services

If you don’t yet have a business website, one of the best things you can do for your Texarkana, AR business is to get in touch with a local digital marketing company, online marketing firm or internet design service and invest in professional website design and SEO services, otherwise known as search engine optimization. Any good marketing agency will tell you that these two things are the foundation of any effective digital marketing campaign and make all the difference in bringing in new leads and customers.

A website acts as your business’s online storefront—it’s the cornerstone of your online marketing presence and gives your potential customers a place to:

  • Learn more about you and your business
  • Read about the products or services you provide
  • See your service area or store location
  • Get in touch with you and convert into a customer

Without a website, good website design and search engine optimization, how are those potential customers going to find your business on Google? How will they know where to contact you? Short answer: They won’t, and they’ll likely go to one of your local competitors, instead.

Tool #2. Social Media Marketing

Most people are on social media these days, so chances are that the majority of your ideal customers are active on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snapchat or all four. So why not deliver your ads to them on a platform they’re familiar with and invested in? A local digital marketing company, online marketing firm, marketing agency or internet design service can help you put together an effective social media marketing strategy.

Social media marketing is a great way to target your ideal Texarkana customers and put your message directly on their feeds where they’re most likely to see and interact with it. Social media marketing also allows you to interact with new and existing customers via your business page, where you can answer questions, respond to reviews, and post about upcoming sales or new products.

Finally, staying active on social media is a great way to boost your search engine optimization rankings and start showing up at the top of search results on Google. If you haven’t added social media marketing to your digital marketing and online marketing to-do list, yet, it might just be the boost your Texarkana, AR business needs to stand out from the crowd.

Tool #3. A Local Digital Marketing Company That Knows Texarkana

Any local digital marketing company, online marketing firm or internet design service you work with should be familiar with your local Texarkana market. Consumer habits and market trends as they relate to website design, SEO services, social media marketing and more tend to vary from city to city and state to state, so finding digital marketing, online marketing and internet design services that work for Texarkana will be invaluable to your business. That previous experience will allow them to:

  • Recommend products and services that fit your business’s long-term online marketing goals.
  • Apply digital marketing services that will appeal to your local audience.
  • Suggest improvements to your digital marketing services to help you get more leads.
  • Create a personalized marketing campaign, including professional website design, SEO services (search engine optimization) and social media marketing.
